items.title: POV: you finally see the house you've been sending money from abroad to build
items.creator: @ryta_may
items.why: Relatable POV skit: diaspora expectation vs shocking reality on arrival; strong emotional hook in first second.
items.idea: POV hook 'You sent money for the house…' then cut to SendFair's real Nairobi cost-to-build breakdown and 'how to check a builder's quote' (/when-a-quote-looks-wrong/).

items.title: Rough estimate cost of this project (cost breakdown replying to comments)
items.creator: @m.oconstruct
items.why: Split screen (3D render on top, builder on site below) with a transparent line-by-line cost answer to a viewer comment.
items.idea: Split screen: house render on top, SendFair calculator numbers below, answering a real follower question 'how much is a 3-bed bungalow in Lagos/Nairobi?' with ranges and source labels.

items.title: Never pay your fundis on daily basis
items.creator: @ambush.contractor
items.why: Bold 'NEVER do X' warning aimed at Kenyans abroad building at home; practical money-saving advice.
items.idea: 'Never accept a builder's quote without checking these 3 lines' using SendFair's real material prices (cement, iron sheets, blocks) for Kenya.

items.title: Make dua for the people you love (forgot to send money to mum)
items.creator: @able_finance
items.why: Emotional story of a son sending money to his mother; product appears only as the happy ending.
items.idea: Simple story reel: 'Mum needs KES 20,000 today' then show how much each provider actually delivers from £ using today's SendFair comparison.

items.title: When we both agreed not to send money home… but the numbers still ain't adding up
items.creator: @flairmicheal
items.why: 13-second relatable couple skit about the 'send money home' pressure; text-on-screen + Afrobeats, loops well.
items.idea: Text-on-screen reel: 'If you must send money home, at least don't lose £X in fees' showing the gap between best and average provider on UK→Nigeria from real data.

items.title: New e-gates at Lagos Airport (Flying to Lagos this December?)
items.creator: @sassy_funke
items.why: Timely December-travel news with POV footage and a 'comment GUIDE' call to action.
items.idea: 'Going home this December? 3 things to sort before you fly' checklist reel: set a rate alert, compare transfers, budget in local currency, ending with sendfair.africa/follow.
